project.name: OpenMind
project.north_star: Turn Achim's nonlinear thinking into linear career capital — without burning premium LLM tokens on housekeeping.

owner.name: Achim Imboden
owner.role: Change management expert + AI Adoption Architect, University of Basel
owner.technical_level: Vibe coder — strong product instincts, comfortable with HTML/JS/CSS, learning backend
owner.collaborator: Sebastian (codebar) — Laravel/PHP expert, joins later phases

problem.core: Projects scattered across Claude projects, ChatGPT projects, Copilot sessions, and VS Code repos — no unified view, no persistent memory, no way to query across all work.
pain_points: Every LLM conversation starts from zero
Project status lives in Achim's head, not in a system
Insights and decisions trapped in chat threads that expire
No portfolio view across all active projects
No semantic search across past thinking
Building tools instead of using them (meta-trap)

vision: One Supabase database that every AI tool reads and writes to. A web dashboard for visual project management. MCP as the bridge. LLM tokens reserved for thinking, never for housekeeping.

architecture.principle: Two data models in one database — relational PM tables for structured project work, Open Brain thoughts table for unstructured knowledge and semantic search. They coexist, they don't compete.

layer_1_brain.name: Supabase
layer_1_brain.role: Single source of truth for all structured and unstructured data
layer_1_brain.plan: Free tier (same project as existing sprint platform)

relational_pm_tables: projects — portfolio of all active work
tasks — actionable items with status, priority, deadlines
content_pipeline — ideas from draft to published
open_brain_layer: thoughts — unstructured captures with vector embeddings
auto-classified metadata — type, topics, people, action items

layer_2_mcp.name: MCP Server (Supabase Edge Function)
layer_2_mcp.role: Bridge between LLMs and the database
tools_exposed: capture_thought — save unstructured insight with auto-embedding
search_thoughts — semantic search across all thoughts
list_thoughts — browse recent captures filtered by type/topic
get_project — retrieve project status and tasks
add_task — create task linked to project
thought_stats — overview of what's in the brain

fallback_capture.why: MCP is ideal but not always reliable across all clients

layer_3_dashboard.name: Web Dashboard
layer_3_dashboard.role: Visual project management interface — read-heavy, capture-light

phase_1: Project detail (tabs: dashboard, deliverables, todos, timeline)
earned_later: Calendar view — when deadline tracking becomes painful
Contact register — when Kindling bridge is needed
Content pipeline tracker — when publishing regularly
Weekly digest viewer — when 4+ digests exist

layer_4_thinkers.name: LLM Tokens
layer_4_thinkers.role: Premium intelligence — strategy, synthesis, content creation only

layer_5_janitor.name: Mac Mini M1 + Ollama
layer_5_janitor.role: Local inference for embedding and classification — DEFERRED
layer_5_janitor.status: Phase 5+ only. Use OpenRouter initially (~$0.10-0.30/month). Build local layer when capturing 50+ thoughts/week.
layer_5_janitor.when_to_activate: When monthly OpenRouter cost exceeds $5 OR when file watcher ingestion is needed

database_schema.extension: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;

meetings.purpose: Meeting notes with extracted action items

contacts.purpose: People connected to projects and work

content_pipeline.purpose: Track content from idea to published

thoughts.purpose: Open Brain — unstructured captures with semantic search
thoughts.index: CREATE INDEX ON thoughts USING ivfflat (embedding vector_cosine_ops) WITH (lists = 100);

database_schema.rls: Service role access only. Single-user system. RLS prevents accidental exposure via REST API.

primary.name: From any LLM via MCP
primary.flow: Valuable thought → tell LLM 'save this to my brain' → MCP capture_thought → Supabase stores with embedding → searchable immediately

secondary.name: Web dashboard quick capture
secondary.flow: Open dashboard → click capture → type or paste → submit → stored in thoughts table

tertiary.name: Slack/Telegram channel
tertiary.flow: Type thought in dedicated channel → webhook → Edge Function → auto-embedded and classified

bulk.name: Drop folder (Phase 5+)
bulk.flow: Save file to ~/openmind-inbox/ → file watcher → qwen2.5:3b extracts → nomic-embed-text embeds → Supabase stores

semantic_search.trigger: Any LLM: 'What do I know about X?'
semantic_search.mechanism: MCP search_thoughts → pgvector cosine similarity → top-k results returned to chat

project_status.trigger: Any LLM: 'What's the status of project Y?'
project_status.mechanism: MCP get_project → returns project + tasks + recent milestones

dashboard_browse.mechanism: Supabase client → SQL queries → rendered in project list/detail views

actions: Capture thoughts from LLM chats as they happen
Update task statuses if something shipped
Zero context switching — capture happens inside the tool you're already using
Query brain: all thoughts from last 7 days
LLM synthesizes recurring themes and patterns
Generate weekly_signal_digest (themes, best insight, LinkedIn draft, next move)
Pick ONE action for the week
Move one content idea to content_pipeline if ready
Semantic search for recurring theme clusters
Career direction check — is positioning still accurate?
Review and refine consulting offer concepts

build_phases.principle: Build in concentric circles. Innermost circle first. Earn each expansion through real usage pain.

phase_1.name: Supabase schema + seed data
phase_1.delivers: All tables created. 3-5 projects seeded. Ready for data.

phase_2.name: Open Brain MCP server (Edge Function)
phase_2.delivers: capture_thought, search_thoughts, list_thoughts, thought_stats working. OpenRouter for embeddings.

phase_3.name: Connect LLMs via MCP
phase_3.delivers: Claude Desktop, Claude Code, ChatGPT connected and tested. Each can save and search thoughts.

phase_4.name: First real weekly digest
phase_4.delivers: Proof the system works. 10-15 real thoughts captured, one real digest generated.
phase_4.gate: DO NOT proceed to Phase 5 until you have done at least 2 weekly digests with real data.

phase_5.name: Minimal web dashboard
phase_5.delivers: Project list page + project detail page (reuse existing design). Quick capture form. Hosted on GitHub Pages.
phase_5.reuses: project-detail.html design system and component patterns

phase_6.name: Extended MCP tools for PM
phase_6.delivers: get_project, update_project, add_task, complete_task MCP tools. LLMs can now manage projects, not just thoughts.

phase_7.name: Mac Mini local inference
phase_7.delivers: Ollama handles embeddings and classification locally. OpenRouter dependency removed. File watcher for bulk ingestion.
phase_7.depends_on: Phase 6 + proven need (50+ thoughts/week OR OpenRouter cost >$5/month)

phase_8.name: Dashboard modules (earned)
phase_8.delivers: Calendar, roadmap, contact register, content pipeline, search — each built only when pain is felt

phase_9.name: Kindling bridge
phase_9.delivers: Contact network integration between OpenMind contacts table and Kindling repo

explicitly_deferred: Mac Mini local inference (until proven cost need)

system_running: All primary LLMs connected via MCP
Dashboard loads with real project data
system_working: Reused a past insight in a real conversation
Found a thought from a different LLM session
Made a decision faster because of retrieved context
Reduced 'I know I thought about this somewhere' moments
Clearer positioning visible in monthly reviews

anti_patterns: Building dashboard modules before capturing 50+ real thoughts
Adding Mac Mini complexity before proving the basic flow works
Burning LLM tokens on housekeeping (embedding, tagging, filing)
Treating the dashboard as the project instead of the means
Designing for multi-user before single-user is validated
Skipping weekly reviews — no review cadence = dead system
Too many thought types at launch — start with insight, decision, task, idea

knowledge_os_v1.kept: Career intelligence focus, weekly digest template, content pipeline concept, anti-patterns, operating cadence
knowledge_os_v1.dropped: OneDrive as primary store, Graphify dependency, markdown-first dogma, folder-based organization

openmind_v1.kept: Mac Mini local inference (deferred), intelligence-at-ingestion principle, database schema thinking, project-centric data model
openmind_v1.dropped: Custom Node.js server as core (now Edge Function), building everything from scratch, Tailscale complexity, immediate local-first requirement

open_brain.kept: Supabase architecture, MCP protocol, multi-LLM memory, semantic search, community-proven patterns
open_brain.dropped: thoughts-only data model (extended with relational PM tables), OpenRouter as permanent solution (will move to local)

sprint_platform.kept: Design system, GitHub Pages hosting, Supabase client patterns, project detail page components
sprint_platform.dropped: Session-based data model, Cloudflare Worker gateway (replaced by Supabase Edge Functions)

existing_tools.supabase_project: Same project as sprint platform — shared infrastructure
